value.account: Added pure scope and loop validation plus exact projection candidate and call-boundary APIs; wired audits into CLI, structural-root executors, and reached calls with checksum/input precedence and narrow atomic failure envelopes. Call frames now use current boundary aliases, validate retry history recursively, reject completed-frame collisions, and allocate deterministic retries; newly created nested retry namespaces remain valid without remapping persisted identities. Projection diagnostics survive routes, loops, cleanup, epilogue and session-close failures, while forensic current steps display as pending. Classic YAML imports reject duplicate effective aliases/sections with source positions before bundle construction. Compiler bundles carry typed Workflow Lisp provenance while classic imports retain object identity and raw compiler bundles retain their existing lexical-policy eligibility. Updated state/acceptance contracts, behavioral fixtures and five projection-metadata goldens. Considered checksum-only or CLI-only guards, but they miss compatible identity drift, direct executors and reached-call races; rejected name/suffix remapping and I/O inside the auditor because they violate exact ownership and audit purity. No schema, run/memo layout, migration evidence or third-party dependency changes. Verification: 1,008 focused tests passed; 212 tests collected; actual CLI nested-call resume and stale-identity smoke passed; whitespace/isolation checks passed. Full suite: 4,823 passed, 47 failed, 13 skipped; all 47 remaining failures reproduced against unchanged HEAD source in an archive inside this checkout. Did not repair those existing environment/evidence, golden, provider or unrelated runtime failures; the full suite remains non-green.
value.summary: Hardened checksum-compatible resume with exact projection ownership audits, deterministic call retry lineage, and sticky failure diagnostics before resumed effects.
